summary.en: The full stop stretches into a bar across the frame, then the bar opens like a window onto the next scene, landing on the downbeat.
summary.zh: 句号墨点横向拉成一条贯穿画面的墨条，墨条再上下张开成窗，露出下一场，落在强拍上。

fits: A cut out of a scene whose last standing mark is a dot or a small shape.
notFor: Scenes without a resting mark; soft transitions.

intent.en: The cut is caused by the dot: the last thing standing opens the next scene.
intent.zh: 切换是墨点引起的：最后留在画面上的东西打开了下一场。

content.en: Two scene painters and the dot's place and radius.
content.zh: 前后两场的绘制函数，以及墨点的位置和半径。

fits.zh: 最后停着一个点或小形状的场景的切出。

notFor.zh: 没有停留标记的场景；柔和的转场。

en: Start it half a beat after the dot has landed; the window must be fully open on the downbeat.
zh: 墨点落稳半拍后再开始；窗要在强拍时完全打开。

overlaps.note: runtime: a shape opening from a point; here the dot first becomes a full-width bar

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
